package.description: The schema version used for this JSON document.

productCode.description: Required. A GUID identifying the package product. ProductCode changes with major upgrades but may be the same for different application versions.

upgradeCode.description: Required. A GUID identifying a product version. UpgradeCode stays constant across all versions of the same application.

template.description: Required. Pre-defined UI installation wizards. Check the documentation for details about all available options. Default 'basic'.

templateSettings.description: Optional. If the template specified require settings this property is used to specify them.

shortcuts.description: Specify which application shortcuts should be create for the application

name.description: Required. Shortcut name displayed to the user.

properties.target: The installed file this shortcut should point to.
